_source: Facts verified on Monad mainnet, chain 143, and from the repository suites. This file is the home for every string a frame puts on screen that a receipt cannot carry: the frame identity, the per-verdict wording, and everything on an open, numbers or end frame. vid/test/test_trace.py holds that line.

frame._note: The rail and the identity block. Not receipt derived: this is who publishes.

receipts._note: One entry per verdict short. Only a receipt published at api.proofofreason.com is rendered; pending entries have no file, no url, no wording and no output. The title and subtitle are this verdict's own words, so a pending verdict cannot borrow the words written for another.

pass.window: typed from the receipt; the 29 Sep takes were run live on Monad mainnet and not screen-recorded, so the receipts are the record
pass.title: THE AGENT STATED ITS REASON.
pass.subtitle: the chain said true. the gate moved the money.

fail.title: THE AGENT STATED A FALSE REASON.
fail.subtitle: the chain said false. the gate refused it. nothing was sent.

wait.title: THE AGENT LEFT OUT A REQUIRED FACT.
wait.subtitle: the gate let it through once its owner signed off.
